question: Which named yogas are included in the stated group of sixteen?
premises: The list includes Harṣaṇa, Varīyān, Śiva, Siddha, Brahma, and Aindra
The group is identified as sixteen
inference: These named yogas belong to a group of sixteen
uncertainties: The remaining members of the sixteen are not listed in this verse
plain_english: Harṣaṇa, Varīyān, Śiva, Siddha, Brahma, and Aindra are among the sixteen.
